title: When the Machine Wakes
author: Sebastian Eastwick
blurb: Rafael Vasquez, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
